manifests.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "cairn-brain"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "A second brain that lives inside your repo: ideas, tasks, decisions and notes as plain Markdown."
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "Juwen Lie" }]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = []
keywords = ["second-brain", "notes", "markdown", "kanban", "adr", "obsidian", "git"]
classifiers = [
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
  "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
  "Operating System :: OS Independent",
  "Environment :: Web Environment",
  "Topic :: Office/Business :: Groupware",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://juw12.github.io/p/cairn/"
App = "https://juw12.github.io/cairn/"
Source = "https://github.com/juw12/cairn"

[project.scripts]
cairn = "cairn.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools]
packages = ["cairn", "cairn.web"]

[tool.setuptools.package-dir]
cairn = "cairn"
"cairn.web" = "docs"

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"cairn.web" = ["*.html", "*.js", "*.css", "*.webmanifest", "icons/*", "media/*"]
